name: Archaeology and Heritage Studies Minor
intro: The minor in Archaeology and Heritage Studies broadens the experience of students preparing for a wide range of professional careers and graduate study. This five-course minor is structured around four required courses: a foundation course, ANTH 202g Archaeology: Our Human Past ; a heritage ethics course to support principled, considered decision-making; an experiential applied methods course; and a capstone course i

notes: Select one course from the Theories and Methods list of the Archaeology and Heritage Studies Major (4 units).
Select any one upper-division course from those listed under Archaeology and Heritage Studies Major (4 units).
Take one course from the Ethics and Heritage list of the Archaeology and Heritage Studies Major (4 units).
